sineFixtureTeardownAbort.detail: 1 s sine deterministically aborts the native binding at process teardown (koffi FATAL after valid stdout JSON, 3/3); espeak/silence children exit clean. Sine fixture excluded from the bench; silence retained as the negative case.

multiWindowTeardownRace.detail: Paced multi-window base fixture: terminating the worker while a superseded window decode is still in flight aborts the child mid-native-call (koffi FATAL after valid stdout JSON, exit 134). profile-run.mjs quiesces 5 s after the final so terminate hits an idle worker; all four bench children exit clean.

networkPosture.audioInTests: synthetic and eSpeak-synthesized PCM only; no audio payload in events or logs (asserted by event-hygiene test)
